steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.bears.directorT=9999; g.env.setTime(9.5); g.env.weather.cloud=0.25; g.env.weather.cloudTarget=0.25; g.env.weather.timer=9999; g.hud.hint && g.hud.hint('',0); __rhf.press('primary'); return 'cast'})()
(()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; const m=f.meter; if(m.phase===1){ m.t=(m.power-0.07)/1.25-0.1; __rhf.press('primary'); } return 'phase '+m.phase})()

(async()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; for(let i=0;i<400;i++){ if(f.encounter && f.encounter.phase==='bite'){ __rhf.press('primary'); return 'hooked at '+i; } if(f.encounter && f.encounter.phase==='approach'){ f.encounter.t=f.encounter.dur; } if(f.encounter && f.encounter.phase==='nibble'){ f.encounter.nibbles=0; f.encounter.gap=0; } await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); } return 'no bite '+f.state})()

(()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; const F=f.fight; if(!F) return 'no fight '+f.state; F.state='jump'; F.jumpT=0.25; F.jumpChecked=true; F.stateT=3; F.tension=f.rod().maxTension*0.55; __rhf.hold('primary', false); return 'jump '+F.fish.species+' '+F.fish.weight.toFixed(1)+' dist '+F.dist.toFixed(1)})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.fishing.cancel(); const r=g.world.roads.find(r=>r.id==='river'); const P=r.path; const p=P.sample(P.length*0.3); const c=g.hotrod; c.place(p.x,p.z,Math.atan2(p.tx,p.tz)); const e=c.exitPoint(1); g.player.place(e.x,e.z,c.yaw); g.env.setTime(17.8); return 'car on river road at '+p.x.toFixed(0)+','+p.z.toFixed(0)})()
